title: Quiz: Built-in Functions
description: Check your understanding of Built-in Functions.

questions.question: Which of these is the correct way to write a comment in Bash?
questions.explanation: In Bash, # marks a comment. Block comments use # (line comments only).

questions.question: What is a "built-in" or standard library function?
options: A ready-made function provided by the language
A function only you can write
questions.correctAnswer: A ready-made function provided by the language
questions.explanation: Standard libraries ship with every language.

questions.question: True or False: You should always write your own version of sorting instead of using built-ins.
questions.explanation: This statement is incorrect — review the lesson.

questions.question: Fill in the blank: len("abc")  // ___ returns 3
questions.explanation: Length functions count items or characters.

questions.question: In Bash, what is the safest way to predict what a program outputs?
options: Depends on the code — trace it line by line
questions.correctAnswer: Depends on the code — trace it line by line
questions.explanation: Read top to bottom, track variable values, and note every output statement.
